records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total revenue growth increased to 28.5% in 2020 from 7.2% in 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Subscription revenue increased by $162.2 million, or 29.9%, in 2020 when compared to 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our customers include multi-national corporations, large domestic and foreign-based enterprises, mid-market companies, public sector organizations, healthcare providers, higher education institutions, non-profit organizations, and small businesses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Free cash flow for the twelve months ended December 31, 2020 was $64.1 million, resulting in a free cash flow margin of 8.6%, as compared to free cash flow of $72.8 million and a free cash flow margin of 12.6 % in 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities for the twelve months ended December 31, 2020 was $96.9 million as compared to $115.5 million during 2019.
